@[reducible, simp]
def discrete_log_naive_precond (g h p : UInt64) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  p.toNat > 1
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_discrete_log (g h p : Nat) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  (Nat.pow g x) % p = h % p

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def dlogAux (g h p : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | _, _, 0 => none
  | cur, i, fuel + 1 =>
      if cur = h % p then some i
      else dlogAux g h p (cur * g % p) (i + 1) fuel
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def discrete_log_naive (g h p : UInt64) (h_precond : discrete_log_naive_precond g h p) : Option UInt64 :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match dlogAux g.toNat h.toNat p.toNat (1 % p.toNat) 0 p.toNat with
  | none => none
  | some x => some (UInt64.ofNat x)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def discrete_log_naive_postcond (g h p : UInt64) (result : Option UInt64) (h_precond : discrete_log_naive_precond g h p) : Prop :=

  match result with
  | some x => is_discrete_log g.toNat h.toNat p.toNat x.toNat ∧ x.toNat < p.toNat ∧
               ∀ k : Nat, k < x.toNat → ¬ is_discrete_log g.toNat h.toNat p.toNat k
  | none => ∀ k : Nat, k < p.toNat → ¬ is_discrete_log g.toNat h.toNat p.toNat k
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

theorem uint64_toNat_lt (p : UInt64) : p.toNat < 2 ^ 64 := by
  first
    | exact p.toBitVec.isLt
    | exact p.toFin.isLt
    | exact UInt64.toNat_lt p
    | exact UInt64.toNat_lt_size p
    | simp [UInt64.toNat]

    first
      | rfl
      | simp [UInt64.toNat_ofNat]
      | simp [UInt64.ofNat, UInt64.toNat, BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
      | simp [UInt64.toNat]
  rw [h, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]

      dlogAux g h p cur i fuel = some x →
      i ≤ x ∧ x < i + fuel ∧ g ^ x % p = h % p ∧
        ∀ k, i ≤ k → k < x → g ^ k % p ≠ h % p := by

  | zero =>
    intro i cur x _ heq

        subst hki
        rw [← hcur]; exact hc

      dlogAux g h p cur i fuel = none →

    · rw [if_neg hc] at heq

          | simp [Nat.mul_mod]

      intro k hk1 hk2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i k with hlt | hge
      · exact hrest k hlt (by omega)
      · have hki : k = i := by omega
        subst hki
        rw [← hcur]; exact hc
-- !benchmark @end lemma

theorem dlogAux_some (g h p : Nat) :
    ∀ (fuel i cur x : Nat), cur = g ^ i % p →
      dlogAux g h p cur i fuel = some x →
      i ≤ x ∧ x < i + fuel ∧ g ^ x % p = h % p ∧
        ∀ k, i ≤ k → k < x → g ^ k % p ≠ h % p := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro i cur x _ heq
    first
      | simp [dlogAux] at heq
      | exact absurd heq (by simp [dlogAux])
  | succ n ih =>
    intro i cur x hcur heq
    simp only [dlogAux] at heq
    by_cases hc : cur = h % p
    · rw [if_pos hc] at heq
      have hx : i = x := Option.some.inj heq
      subst hx
      refine ⟨Nat.le_refl _, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hcur]; exact hc
      · intro k hk1 hk2; exfalso; omega
    · rw [if_neg hc] at heq
      have hcur' : cur * g % p = g ^ (i + 1) % p := by
        rw [hcur, pow_succ]
        first
          | exact (Nat.mod_modEq (g ^ i) p).mul_right g
          | simp [Nat.mul_mod]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih (i + 1) (cur * g % p) x hcur' heq
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, h3, ?_⟩
      intro k hk1 hk2
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge i k with hlt | hge
      · exact h4 k hlt hk2
      · have hki : k = i := by omega
        subst hki
        rw [← hcur]; exact hc
